dedupe_keys.name: using colored petri nets for verifying restful service composition

description: Kallab, Lara and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The documented method models resources and REST service composition using Colored Petri Nets, then checks relevant behaviour properties. An executed scenario uses the HIT2GAP energy-management web environment, establishing a concrete supporting role for building-energy services. This is a formal model of service composition for the stated building-energy application. The inspected abstract does not claim a standalone software package, specify all verified properties or demonstrate every deployed service. It supports checking the correctness of the software interactions that deliver energy-management analyses. Parent-book ISBNs identify the container and are not treated as exact identities of this individual contribution. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-sa-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; a paper licence does not establish a software licence. Coverage is limited to the stated sites, model settings and application examples. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
